description: catalogue.datara.gouv.fr: dams and flood defences datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.datara.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by catalogue.datara.gouv.fr. The listing groups 9 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about dams and flood defences; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Barrages de retenue et digues de canaux - Isère; Digue de protection contre les inondations et digue de rivières canali; Ouvrage de retenue d'eau - Isère; Barrages hydroélectriques de type linéaire en Auvergne Rhône-Alpes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
